$description: Papercusp app-family semantic theme tokens (D-011, plan unified-web-portal-2026-08-29). One DTCG source of truth for the warm paper/ink palette shared by every papercusp-app-composed surface (portal, email, calendar, dashboard per D-013). `$value` is the LIGHT mode value; dark lives in $extensions['com.papercusp.modes'].dark. Regenerate tokens.css with: node generate-tokens.mjs (or --check to verify drift). Apps consume the GENERATED tokens.css and never hardcode these values — a raw hex in app CSS is the defect this package exists to remove.

ink-soft.$description: CSS var --ink-soft: secondary text (nav items, de-emphasized labels)

line-soft.$description: CSS var --line-soft: subtle separators (list-row borders, inner card rules)

line-strong.$description: CSS var --line-strong: emphasized border (composer, focused chrome)

panel-dim.$description: CSS var --panel-dim: secondary surface between paper and panel (list panes)

panel-raised.$description: CSS var --panel-raised: highest surface (cards, popovers, composer)

rail.$description: CSS var --rail: navigation rail / sidebar background

chip.$description: CSS var --chip: chip/inline-button fill on panel surfaces

accent.$description: CSS var --accent: primary interactive accent (per-app accents override this in an app overlay layer, never here)

accent-soft.$description: CSS var --accent-soft: accent tint fill (badges, selected chips)
